## About me

Industry-focused Data Analyst with 10 years of experience in supply chain and quality (procurement, production scheduling, traceability, raw-material risk), I turn your production and logistics data into reliable decision-making tools. 
:::

::::

Having dealt with these challenges firsthand, I understand the realities of the business. I have built and automated raw-material risk databases and set up supply chain KPIs (procurement and production scheduling for around ten plants).

## Recommandations


::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
I had the pleasure of working with Agnès for several years in the Quality team, which she joined as a young engineer.  
She is very comfortable with IT tools and quickly became the team's go-to person on these topics. She developed and evolved many quality applications, always starting from users' real needs.  
She played a key role in setting up and rolling out our supplier specifications management platform. This project connected all of our suppliers and consolidated the specifications into a model dedicated to each product family. On this demanding, multi-year data structuring project, I could count on her from start to finish.  
Rigorous, pragmatic and attentive, Agnès knows how to understand a business before proposing a solution. She is a reliable and trustworthy professional.  
I'm delighted to see her starting out as a freelance Data Analyst. I recommend her without hesitation!
